The same expression is (sqrt(p_h)-sqrt(q_h))^2 + sqrt(p_h) sqrt(q_h) H2(k_h,l_h). Summing proves the stated identity without parent normalization. sqrt(p_h q_h) equals sqrt(p_h) sqrt(q_h) under the stated signs.

Word perturbation at most q eta, squared-state-distance domination of basis H2, and q <= D yield H2(k_E,k_F) <= D q eta_arm^2. Any squaring step needs q eta >= 0, obtained from nonnegative operator norm and the distance premise.
AM-GM gives sqrt(p_E p_F) <= (p_E+p_F)/2. Nonnegative D and charge permit multiplication, so the increment is bounded by D/2 times the two own-law expected next charges.
Expanding the actual density and additive prior-history cost and summing the new outcome yields EC(n+1)=EC(n)+sum_h p(n,h)w(h). The zero-block base and induction give the weighted root.

For uniform eta, C=Q eta^2. The pathwise horizon and derived density mass one give each EC <= T eta^2, hence H2 <= D T eta^2. No unbiasedness, conditional-information hypothesis, or estimation-error independence enters.
